tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List Ply registry components filtered by tier, category, or a case-insensitive substring, sorted by name. Not a fuzzy match: search_components ranks uncertain names, and get_component reads one known name. Does not install. To copy a component into a project, tell the user to run npx ply-ui-cli add

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get registry metadata for one known component (deps, category, file list). Use search_components when the name is uncertain. Free source only when includeSource=true. Pro source is never streamed via MCP. Does not install; returns installCommand (npx ply-ui-cli add <name>).

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Rank Ply registry components by a fuzzy or token match when the name is uncertain (for example "dialog modal"). Not a category browse: list_components filters by tier, category, or substring, and get_component reads one known name. Does not install. To copy a match into a project, tell the user to r

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_components" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
